notes: Fixed voice notes that would not play. Your recordings now play in the Keep, even after the text is made.
Fixed the tab rows sliding the whole page sideways. Tabs on a Keep, the filters on Trove and the buttons in the Add sheet now scroll on their own.
A soft fade now shows at the edge when there is more to scroll to, and the tab you pick scrolls into view.
Voice note now sits right next to Paste in the Add sheet.
